Numerically independently checked 1008 cases with packaged verifier; the infinity statement relies on this analytic proof, not finite experiments. value.rationale: The 2026 motivating paper directly targets Nyström plus one Gaussian trace probe but its published generic guarantee requires positive oversampling, whereas the new sharp contrast-uniform error threshold shows zero oversampling ell=r suffices in the natural two-level spike model. The structural decomposition isolates missed spikes and the distinction between divergent ordinary inverse moments and finite logarithmic moments explains the precise threshold. It provides a mathematically justified sketch-budget phase boundary rather than a reparameterization or a finite experiment. No general-spectrum, finite-precision, or Lanczos truncation benefit is claimed.
